codedata.sourceCode:
final ai:Agent concreteExplicitAgent = check new (systemPrompt = {role: "a", instructions: "b"}, model = model,
    memory = concreteExplicitMemory, tools = []);

metadata.label: Role
metadata.description: Define the agent's primary function

role.placeholder: e.g., Customer Support Assistant, Sales Advisor, Data Analyst

metadata.label: Instructions
metadata.description: Detailed instructions for the agent

instructions.placeholder: e.g., You are a friendly assistant. Your goal is to...

metadata.label: System Prompt
metadata.description: The system prompt assigned to the agent

metadata.label: Memory
metadata.description:
The memory used by the agent to store and manage conversation history.
Defaults to use an in-memory message store that trims on overflow, if unspecified.

metadata.label: Model
metadata.description: The model used by the agent

metadata.label: Tools
metadata.description: The tools available for the agent

metadata.label: Maximum Iterations
metadata.description:
The maximum number of reasoning-action cycles the agent performs to complete the task.
A single cycle is one LLM call plus the execution of every tool call returned in
that response, so multiple tool calls from one response count as one iteration.
Defaults to `max(number of tools, 10)` — i.e., at least 10, or more if the
agent has more tools available.

metadata.label: Verbose
metadata.description: Specifies whether verbose logging is enabled

metadata.label: Tool Loading Strategy
metadata.description:
Defines the strategies for loading tool schemas into an Agent.
By default, all tools are loaded without any filtering.

metadata.label: Execute Tool Calls In Parallel

metadata.label: Store
metadata.description:
The memory store to use; if not provided, an in-memory store is used. The same
store persists both the conversation history and human-in-the-loop pause checkpoints, so a
store with a durable backend makes both durable.

metadata.label: Overflow Configuration
metadata.description: The strategy to handle overflow; if not provided, trimming is used
